name: detectai-worker-cron (${environment})
description: Cron sweeper: ticks, batches, subscription retries. service.name = worker-cron.

pages.name: Worker cron
pages.description: Schedule adherence, batch efficiency, sweep outcomes

rawConfiguration.text:
## Worker cron (`worker-cron`, `${environment}`, sampler always_on)
Sweep every `CRON_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS` (default 900000), batch `CRON_BATCH_SIZE` (default 100). Missed tick = no successful tick for 2x interval. Tick duration must stay below interval.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT rate(count(*), 1 hour) AS `ticks/h` WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND message LIKE '%tick%' OR message LIKE '%sweep%' OR message LIKE '%cron%'
FROM Log SELECT latest(timestamp) AS `last tick` WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Log SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE level = 'error') AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Log SELECT average(numeric(`processed`)) AS `avg processed` WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS ticks WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n FACET message WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%sweep%' OR message LIKE '%subscription%' OR message LIKE '%expired%' OR message LIKE '%paused%') LIMIT 25
FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND level = 'error' FACET message LIMIT 20
FROM Span SELECT average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms` WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND span.kind = 'CLIENT' FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
